id: title:dmarticus:show manual update results when notifications are off

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop application user preference enforcement and notification delivery
review.reason: Adds an optional `alwaysShow` boolean to the Toast API, allowing callers to override the global 'toast notifications disabled' setting. P1.F4.H1 introduces the option; P1.F4.H2 implements the suppression and override logic; P1.F1.H1 demonstrates the use case where the Desktop app explicitly requests an update toast to remain visible despite user preferences. review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the Desktop app's adoption and the user's preference configuration, neither of which are verified by this code change. No broader systemic risk or adoption metrics are demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context or truncation. All hunks are complete and relevant.

observations.behavior: Adds an optional `alwaysShow` boolean option to the Toast API and its options interface.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows callers to override the global 'toast notifications disabled' setting, forcing a toast to render regardless of user preference.

observations.behavior: Updates the success toast call to use the new `alwaysShow: true` option.
observations.posthog_connection: Demonstrates the intended use case: the Desktop app explicitly requests the update toast to remain visible even if the user has disabled notifications.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check in the toast emission logic: if the level is not an error, the caller did not request `alwaysShow`, and the user has disabled notifications, the toast is suppressed.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements the suppression behavior while allowing the override; this preserves the existing behavior for non-error, non-always-show toasts while enabling the new override.
